_style: Modern editorial digital illustration for an English learning platform for teenagers (B1). Clean shapes, soft grain texture, gentle shadows, warm light. Brand palette: electric blue #3D3BFF, pink #FF4FA3, yellow #FFD400, orange #FF7A00, cream background #F7F4ED, graphite outlines. Not childish, not photorealistic. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks. 16:9 landscape, 2K.
